style: flat vector cartoon, thick dark outlines, bold neon stage lighting, chunky casual mobile game art
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word inside every prompt. Orientation is declared in words for every mechanical sprite: the shield segment puts its outer convex edge at the TOP (the code rotates it so local up points away from the crystal), the crimson shard points RIGHT because local right is its flight direction, the lane rail runs VERTICALLY top to bottom and the bunting runs HORIZONTALLY because both are drawn nine-sliced along that axis, and the two turn arrows and the back chevron are the only other asymmetric pieces. Everything else is symmetric and is never flipped. Sprite backgrounds are matted out by the pipeline, so no prompt argues about background colour. There is no audio in this project. Nothing carries a name, a word, a letter or a logo.
